{{Top|leg}}
'''Merkur's Cab Service''' was a [[Air taxi/Legends|taxi]] service based in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tal'cara]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] and was established by a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] named [[Merkur]].

The company was housed in an old vehicle bay in the [[Warehouse district (Tal'cara)|warehouse district]] of Tal'cara bought by Merkur. Its fleet consisted of several [[XP-32-1 Landspeeder]]s (old and used, which Merkur had overhauled and refurbished) driven by five [[V1 pilot droid]]s (which Merkur had purchased and reprogrammed).<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

The business had some high-ranking Bothans as customers, charging 2 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per half hour, having some advantages over [["The Loop" (unirail)|The Loop]] [[monorail/Legends|unirail]]. Merkur was kept always busy maintaining and servicing his speeders.<ref name="guide" />
